description: Overall-status outcomes for combinations of per-artifact success/failure and required/optional flags, per docs/bible/09-foundry/205-export-failure-and-partial-success.md.
currentImplementationCaveat: No current code computes or returns any of these four overallStatus values explicitly. Each export endpoint is called and evaluated independently by the client; the client itself effectively determines the overall outcome by observing which of its own independent calls succeeded or failed. This vocabulary is the TARGET shape for a future unified export-orchestration response — see docs/bible/08-alchemist/173-partial-compilation-policy.md for the identical finding at the compiler level.
